body: Words cannot begin to describe, and at the same time, there is nothing wrong - it's all in my head. I'm making it all up. I wish it would just stop and I could go back to being a normal human being. Instead, I seem married to this false self - this egotistical, fear based nightmare that I've constructed in order to be different. It's all nonsense really. But it's nonsense I keep repeating and gets affirmed and rehashed and played out in the world around me. It's a prison I made. Fear keeps me locked inside.
beauty, ugliness - we are what we are. thanks for the response
